# Vendored libraries

- `qrcode.js` - QR Code Generator for JavaScript v2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase,
  MIT license (see header of the file). https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
  Used to draw event check-in QR codes. Kept as a local file so the portal has no
  extra runtime dependency on a CDN.
